kind of climate and generator assumption is made?","answer":"Assumes a temperate climate and no backup generator"},{"factIndex":3,"question":"How many litres of water per person per day should be stored?","answer":"Store four litres per person per day"},{"factIndex":4,"question":"How many litres per person is this for the full seventy-two hours, and how is it split?","answer":"twelve litres per person for the full seventy-two hours; half for drinking, half for cooking and basic hygiene"},{"factIndex":5,"question":"What kind of containers should be used for stored water, and how often should they be replaced?","answer":"Use food-grade containers kept out of direct sunlight; replace stored water every six months"},{"factIndex":6,"question":"Where should you fill water if a storm is shelf of non-perishable, no-cook food contain for three days?","answer":"canned beans, canned fish, peanut butter, crackers, dried fruit, shelf-stable milk"},{"factIndex":8,"question":"What tool must you own because an electric one will be useless?","answer":"a manual can opener"},{"factIndex":9,"question":"In what order should you eat food during the outage?","answer":"perishable food from the freezer?","answer":"an unopened refrigerator about four hours; a full freezer about forty-eight hours; a half-full freezer about twenty-four hours"},{"factIndex":11,"question":"What should be done with both doors of the refrigerator and freezer?","answer":"Keep both doors closed as much as possible and tape a reminder note to each door"},{"factIndex":12,"question":"How should the freezer be kept even if some space is containers of frozen water?","answer":"Keep the freezer consolidated and full, even if some space is containers of frozen water"},{"factIndex":13,"question":"When should you discard perishable food based on temperature?","answer":"spent more than two hours above four degrees Celsius"},{"factIndex":14,"question":"What is the primary source of light recommended?","answer":"battery-powered LED lanterns or headlamps"},{"factIndex":15,"question":"Why should candles be avoided entirely?","answer":"they are a leading cause of house fires during outages"},{"factIndex":16,"question":"How many lights and spare batteries should be stored?","answer":"Store at least one light per person plus two spare sets of batteries for each light"},{"factIndex":17,"question":"Where should headlamps and lanterns be placed?","answer":"Keep one headlamp beside each bed and one lantern in the kitchen; place them where they can be found in the dark"},{"factIndex":18,"question":"Where must you never run a camping stove, barbecue, or generator?","answer":"indoors, in a garage, or near a window"},{"factIndex":19,"question":"What gas do camping stoves, barbecues, and generators produce that is odourless and fatal?","answer":"each produces carbon monoxide, which is odourless and can be fatal"},{"factIndex":20,"question":"What safety alarm should be installed on each floor where people sleep?","answer":"battery-powered carbon monoxide alarm on each floor where people sleep"},{"factIndex":21,"question":"In cold weather, what kind more reliably than voice calls"},{"factIndex":27,"question":"What medical supplies should be kept and rotated?","answer":"a first-aid kit and a seven-day supply of every prescription paper"},{"factIndex":30,"question":"How long should you wait before switching major appliances back on when power returns?","answer":"Wait five minutes before switching major appliances back
